raw:
Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert  
Step Number: 30  
Reason for Mistake: The DataVerification_Expert failed to identify correctly that there could be board members of Apple's Board besides the listed group who did not hold C-suite positions before joining. The analysis was based solely on the list provided, assuming it was exhaustive, rather than verifying against the complete and up-to-date board membership as of October 2023. It overlooked the critical task requirement to confirm that the list provided was comprehensive, causing potentially incomplete verification of all relevant board members.
